COMPATIBILITY COMES FIRST

A ball finial is the ornament at the top of many flagpoles. A matching appearance is only part of the selection: the connection to the pole-top assembly matters too.

01

Connection details

Provide a model number or existing product record where possible. Threads and mounting arrangements vary between products.

02

Display proportions

Share the approximate pole height and existing finial size if documented. Final selection should suit the chosen pole assembly.

03

Access and replacement

A missing or damaged finial may involve work at height. Include access constraints and whether the whole top assembly needs review.

MAKE YOUR REQUEST USEFUL

A better brief.
A clearer quote.

Share ground-level photos, manufacturer information and any records of the original finial. Do not attempt to remove a top fitting to obtain a measurement.

Product options, compatibility, stock and lead times are confirmed for your request.

REQUEST A PARTS QUOTE

GOOD TO KNOW

A few useful answers.

Does a new finial include a new pulley assembly?

Not necessarily. The ornament and the truck or pulley assembly can be separate components. The quote should identify exactly what is included.

What if I do not know the model or dimensions?

Send the information you have, including existing records and photos taken from a safe position. Do not climb, dismantle or alter the display to complete the enquiry.
